mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_survey ( SURVEY_ID, SURVEY_TITLE, OPENED, CLOSED, ADMINEMAIL, ADMINPID, ACCESSRESULTSRESTRICTION, RESULTSPASSWORD, ENTRYRESTRICTION, ENTRYPASSWORD, MEMBERS, ONEENTRYONLY, SHOWBORDER, EXPORTDELIMITER, EXPORTINCLUDEQUESTIONS, IP, BROWSERID, BGCOLOR, TEXTCOLOR, FONT_SIZE, HEADER, FOOTER, BASEHREF, USERCSS, DIVIDER, EXITPAGETEXT_ISHTML, EXITPAGETEXT, NUMBERRODUCTIONTEXT, THEME_SEQ, LOGO_IMAGE_PATH, LOGO_ALIGN, SHOW_FOOTER_LOGO, LAYOUT_TYPE, FONT_FAMILY, ACCENT_COLOR, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDUSR_NO, UPDT_DT ) VALUES ( #{surveyId}, #{surveyTitle}, #{opened}, #{closed}, #{adminEmail}, #{adminPid}, #{accessResultsRestriction}, #{resultsPassword}, #{entryRestriction}, #{entryPassword}, #{members}, #{oneEntryOnly}, #{showBorder}, #{exportDelimiter}, #{exportIncludeQuestions}, #{ip}, #{browserId}, #{bgColor}, #{textColor}, #{fontSize}, #{header}, #{footer}, #{baseHref}, #{userCss}, #{divider}, #{exitPageTextIsHtml}, #{exitPageText}, #{numberRoductionText}, #{themeSeq}, #{logoImagePath}, #{logoAlign}, #{showFooterLogo}, #{layoutType}, #{fontFamily}, #{accentColor}, #{registerNo}, NOW(), #{updusrNo}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO tb_section ( SURVEY_ID, SECTION_ID, SECTION_TITLE, SECTION_HTMLTITLE, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDUSR_NO, UPDT_DT ) VALUES ( #{surveyId}, #{sectionId}, #{sectionTitle}, #{sectionHtmlTitle}, #{registerNo}, NOW(), #{updusrNo}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO tb_question ( SURVEY_ID, SECTION_ID, QUESTION_ID, QUESTION_TYPE, SHOWDIVIDER, EXPORTINCLUDE, EXPORTEXPAND, QUESTIONTEXT, QUESTION_CD, QUESTION_ISHTML, QUESTION_LAYOUT, QUESTION_LABEL, OTHERANSWER, TEXTCOLS, TEXTROWS, TEXTSIZE, MAXLENGTH, SUMMARY_CD, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDUSR_NO, UPDT_DT ) VALUES ( #{surveyId}, #{sectionId}, #{questionId}, #{questionType}, #{showDivider}, #{exportInclude}, #{exportExpand}, #{questionText}, #{questionCd}, #{questionIsHtml}, #{questionLayout}, #{questionLabel}, #{otherAnswer}, #{textCols}, #{textRows}, #{textSize}, #{maxLength}, #{summaryCd}, #{registerNo}, NOW(), #{updusrNo}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO tb_question_label ( SURVEY_ID, SECTION_ID, QUESTION_ID, QUESTION_LABEL_ID, QUESTION_LABEL, EXPORTCODE, SELECTED, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDUSR_NO, UPDT_DT ) VALUES ( #{surveyId}, #{sectionId}, #{questionId}, #{questionLabelId}, #{questionLabel}, #{exportCode}, #{selected}, #{registerNo}, NOW(), #{updusrNo}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO tb_results ( RESULTS_ID, SURVEY_ID, SECTION_ID, QUESTION_ID, QUESTION_RESULT, OTHERANSWER_RESULT, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDUSR_NO, UPDT_DT ) VALUES ( #{resultsId}, #{surveyId}, #{sectionId}, #{questionId}, #{questionResult}, #{otherAnswerResult}, #{registerNo}, NOW(), #{updusrNo}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO tb_results_label ( RESULTS_ID, RESULTS_LABEL_ID, SURVEY_ID, SECTION_ID, QUESTION_ID, QUESTION_LABEL_ID, QUESTION_LABEL_RESULT, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDUSR_NO, UPDT_DT ) VALUES ( #{resultsId}, #{resultsLabelId}, #{surveyId}, #{sectionId}, #{questionId}, #{questionLabelId}, #{questionLabelResult}, #{registerNo}, NOW(), #{updusrNo}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT L.QUESTION_LABEL_ID as labelId, L.QUESTION_LABEL as labelText, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_results_label RL WHERE RL.SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} AND RL.QUESTION_ID = #{questionId} AND RL.QUESTION_LABEL_ID = L.QUESTION_LABEL_ID) as count FROM tb_question_label L WHERE L.SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} AND L.QUESTION_ID = #{questionId} ORDER BY L.QUESTION_LABEL_ID ASC
SELECT * FROM tb_results WHERE SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} AND QUESTION_ID = #{questionId} AND QUESTION_RESULT IS NOT NULL AND QUESTION_RESULT != '' ORDER BY REGIST_DT DESC

SELECT RESULTS_ID as resultsId, SUBSTRING_INDEX(QUESTION_RESULT, ',', 1) as lat, SUBSTRING_INDEX(QUESTION_RESULT, ',', -1) as lng FROM tb_results WHERE SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} AND QUESTION_ID = #{questionId} AND QUESTION_RESULT LIKE '%,%'
SELECT RESULTS_ID as resultsId, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(REGIST_DT), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as registDt FROM tb_results WHERE SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} GROUP BY RESULTS_ID ORDER BY MIN(REGIST_DT) DESC
SELECT * FROM tb_results WHERE SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} AND RESULTS_ID = #{resultsId}
SELECT * FROM tb_results_label WHERE SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} AND RESULTS_ID = #{resultsId}
